label: SIMULATED - sample corridor, synthetic disruptions, not real railway data

methods.NO_REPLANNING: first come, first served at the signals
methods.PRIORITY_DISPATCH: the waiting train with the highest priority enters first
methods.SINGLE_SHOT: COMBINED CP-SAT once, when the first disruption becomes known
methods.DYNAMIC: COMBINED re-solved whenever a new event becomes known, on top of the current plan (started trips fixed, 120-min horizon)
methods.DYNAMIC_ML: dynamic + ML risk buffers (+1 min headway on trips the conflict model flags)
methods.DYNAMIC_ML_B2: as dynamic + ML with +2 min on flagged trips (10b, A)
methods.DYNAMIC_ML_B3: as dynamic + ML with +3 min on flagged trips (10b, A)
methods.DYNAMIC_ML_PROP: every upcoming trip gets round(3 x conflict probability) min (10b, B)
methods.DYNAMIC_ML_TRIGGER: dynamic + a model check every 10 min; a newly flagged train with no rule conflict triggers a re-solve (10b, C)

single_shot_guarantee.note: The by-construction claim covers the events known when the solver ran. On the full replay, disruptions that become known later can make a fixed single-shot plan worse; those cases are listed, not hidden.
